summary: Iteration 7 tested the Verified face badge, share-stats and native-voice TTS fallback at a 390x844 viewport. Backend: 9/9 pytest passed (test_partner_iter7_face_sharestats_tts.py). A real Unsplash portrait JPEG went through upload, then avatar, and returned face_verified=true. /partner/me showed face_verified=true, fixa.demo's FIXA item got 'Verified face' added to fixa_badges and seller_face_verified=true, and adaeze's properties got agent_face_verified=true. A sofa photo returned false and removed the badge. The AI check took about 1-2s. Share-stats: two browser-UA opens on /api/go/{pid} and /api/partner/go/item/{iid} each added 2. WhatsApp/2.23 opens added nothing on either route. total equals the sum, FIXA services are left out, and the endpoint returns 401 without a token. TTS yo/ha/ig returned 200 with audio/mpeg (over 1KB) through the OpenAI fallback, with no 500 and no spitch log lines because the key is not set. Frontend: Me shows me-face-hint while unverified. Uploading the face photo through the gallery showed the toast 'Photo saved. You now have the Verified face badge!' and the green me-face-badge, and the badge was still there after a reload. The sofa photo showed the 'could not see one clear face' toast and the hint came back. Work>Homes cards show the link icon with count 2 (listing-link-opens-{id}). The listing detail third tile reads '2 Link opens'. The seller item card shows 'Opened 6 times' only when the count is above 0 (1 of 2 cards). Item detail shows 'Link opens: 6'. All demo data I changed was restored: fixa.demo avatar and badges, adaeze properties, click counters and the social_link_clicks rows I created. New issues are listed below; the biggest is the raw i18n key 'status_premium' on premium listings.

minor.issue: Any exception (LLM timeout, network, image fetch) returns False. A short outage therefore REMOVES a badge the partner already earned and shows 'could not see one clear face'. The check should tell 'not a face' apart from 'check failed' (keep the old state or return face_verified:null and ask to retry).

No rate limit. Every call costs one gpt-5.4 vision call, and repeated calls can run up LLM cost. The URL guard only checks the /api/public-files/ prefix, so any public photo works, including another user's listing photo of a person. The badge shows that a face is present, not whose face it is.
Opens are not de-duplicated. Refreshes, or the seller opening their own link, raise the count. Acceptable for an MVP.
Seeded agent avatars that are real faces (e.g. adaeze's Unsplash portrait) were never face-checked, so no demo partner has the badge until they upload again. There is no backfill.

ui_bugs.issue: Key 'status_premium' is missing from i18n.ts, so the raw text 'status_premium' shows on Work>Homes cards and on the listing detail (listing-status). adaeze has 4 premium listings.

'Show again' (listing-status-available) appears for premium listings because status != 'available'. Tapping it would probably turn a premium listing into a plain available one. Needs a business-logic check.
'Opened {n} times' has no plural form, so a count of 1 reads 'Opened 1 times'.

issues: PhotoAdder.upload calls onChange without awaiting it, so the spinner stops when the upload finishes and NOT when the AI face check finishes. During the check (1-2s here, up to about 20s when slow) the sheet stays open with Camera/Gallery enabled, with no progress shown and a double submit possible.
The result toast first appears under the dimmed backdrop of the closing sheet, and the old avatar stays visible for a moment before the new one loads.

action_items: Add status_premium (and any other property statuses) to every language in i18n.ts. Hide or relabel 'Show again' for premium listings.
In _check_face, return a three-state result (True/False/error). On error, keep the existing face_verified and badge and show a 'could not check, try again' toast.
Rate-limit POST /api/partner/avatar per user (e.g. 5 per hour) to cap vision LLM cost.
Me photo sheet: show a 'Checking your photo…' spinner and disable the buttons until /partner/avatar returns (await onChange in PhotoAdder or keep a local busy state).
Plural form for opened_times when n == 1.
Optional: backfill a face check for seeded demo avatars, or document that the badge needs a new upload.
critical_code_review_comments: partner_app.py:398 swallows every exception as 'no face', which hides outages and removes earned badges.
The face check fetches the image back over the public URL (an extra round trip through ingress). The uploaded bytes could be checked directly instead.

The Spitch call matches the docs (POST /v1/speech with text, language, voice, format=mp3, raw audio bytes back; voices sade/amina/ngozi are valid) and has a separate cache key. Not tested live because SPITCH_API_KEY is not set.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows; 3 new UI bugs found outside the requested scope

A leftover 'TEST_ Ui Buyer offers' offer from an earlier iteration is still on the seller fridge item.
